title: Private Markets Fund Document Extraction
summary: Read capital calls, distribution notices, capital account statements and LPAs from many GPs into structured records, with roll-forward checks and wire-instruction change alerts.

seo.title: Private Markets Fund Document Extraction AI | VipraTech
seo.description: AI for LPs, family offices and fund administrators that extracts capital calls, distributions, capital accounts and LPA terms, with checks and alerts.

problem.intro: An LP with commitments across private equity, venture, credit and real estate funds receives a steady stream of documents from each GP: capital call and drawdown notices, distribution notices, quarterly capital account statements, quarterly reports and audited financials. Every GP uses its own format and portal, and operations teams key the figures into spreadsheets or the accounting system.

pain_points.title: Formats differ by GP
pain_points.detail: Each GP and administrator lays out notices and statements differently, so template-based tools need constant maintenance.

pain_points.title: Cash deadlines are tight
pain_points.detail: Capital calls carry due dates, and a notice missed in a portal or inbox becomes a late payment.

pain_points.title: Wire instruction changes are a fraud risk
pain_points.detail: A changed bank account on a capital call notice may be legitimate or a payment fraud attempt, and it must be caught every time.

pain_points.title: Roll-forwards that do not tie
pain_points.detail: Capital account statements must roll from opening to closing balance through contributions, distributions, fees and gains, and breaks are found late.

solution.overview: We build a fund document pipeline for LPs, family offices and fund administrators. It collects documents from GP portals and inboxes, classifies them and extracts what operations and accounting need: call amounts, due dates and purpose, distribution components, capital account movements, NAV and fees. Every capital account statement is checked for arithmetic and tied to your commitment register, and bank details on each notice are compared with your verified instruction master. Breaks go to an analyst; any change in wire instructions is blocked and sent for callback verification by treasury. Clean records post to your accounting or portfolio monitoring system, and LPA and side-letter terms go into a searchable register.
capabilities: Classifies capital calls, distribution notices, capital account statements, quarterly reports, LPAs, side letters and PPMs
Extracts call amounts, due dates and purpose, and splits distributions into return of capital, gains, income and withholding
Checks capital account roll-forwards and ties them to your commitment register and unfunded balance
Compares bank details on every notice with your verified instruction master and blocks changes
Builds a register of key LPA and side-letter terms such as fees, hurdle, key person and most-favoured-nation provisions
Posts validated records to your accounting or portfolio monitoring system and cash forecast

workflow.title: Collect documents
workflow.detail: Notices and statements are gathered from GP portals and inboxes and tagged by fund and investing entity.

workflow.title: Classify and extract
workflow.detail: Each document type has its own schema for amounts, dates, components and balances.

workflow.title: Validate
workflow.detail: Roll-forwards, commitment balances and bank details are checked against your records.

workflow.title: Handle exceptions
workflow.detail: Breaks go to an operations analyst; wire instruction changes are blocked for treasury callback verification.

workflow.title: Post and forecast
workflow.detail: Validated records post to accounting and update the cash forecast and unfunded commitments.

workflow.title: Maintain the terms register
workflow.detail: LPA and side-letter terms are extracted for legal review and kept in a searchable register.

human_in_the_loop: Operations analysts approve every cash movement record and resolve breaks. Any change in bank details is blocked until treasury completes an out-of-band callback, and legal reviews extracted side-letter terms before anyone relies on them.
integrations: GP investor portals and data rooms
Investment accounting or portfolio monitoring platform

Bank detail changes always blocked pending callback verification
Arithmetic checks on every capital account statement
Every value linked to its source page

Payment fraud controls such as callback verification stay with your treasury team; the system only raises and records the alert.

faqs.q: How do you cope with so many GP formats?
faqs.a: The extractor reads documents in context rather than relying on fixed templates, so new layouts work without set-up. The first documents from any new GP are reviewed by an analyst to confirm the mapping.

faqs.q: Does it work for Indian AIF documents?
faqs.a: Yes. Drawdown notices, NAV statements and unitholder statements from Indian AIFs use the same approach, with schemas that reflect their terminology.

faqs.q: Can it pull documents from GP portals automatically?
faqs.a: Where portals allow it, we automate downloads with credentials held in your secrets store. Where they do not, documents can be forwarded or dropped into a watched folder.
The system compares bank details on every notice with your verified master and blocks any change. Verification happens by callback through your treasury process, outside the AI.
